examples.en: The bank is the largest creditor of the company.
examples.zh: 這家銀行是該公司最大的債權人。

examples.en: The creditors sent several letters asking for payment.
examples.zh: 債權人寄了好幾封信要求付款。

examples.en: He owes money to a creditor and must pay it back by June.
examples.zh: 他欠一位債權人錢，必須在六月前還清。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep in her crib.
examples.zh: 寶寶在她的嬰兒床裡睡著了。

examples.en: We bought a new crib for our daughter.
examples.zh: 我們為女兒買了一張新的嬰兒床。

examples.en: Please do not put any toys in the crib.
examples.zh: 請不要把任何玩具放進嬰兒床裡。

examples.en: The crook cheated many old people out of their savings.
examples.zh: 那個騙子騙走了許多老人的積蓄。

examples.en: She held the baby in the crook of her arm.
examples.zh: 她把寶寶抱在臂彎裡。

examples.en: Don't trust that crook; he sold me a fake watch.
examples.zh: 別相信那個騙子，他賣給我一支假錶。

examples.en: The picture on the wall is crooked.
examples.zh: 牆上的畫掛歪了。

examples.en: A crooked path led up the hill.
examples.zh: 一條彎曲的小路通往山上。

examples.en: The crooked salesman cheated his customers.
examples.zh: 那位不老實的業務員欺騙了他的顧客。

examples.en: She joined the cross-country team at school.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校的越野隊。

examples.en: We took a cross-country train trip last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天搭火車橫越全國旅行。

examples.en: The cross-country race is held in the park each autumn.
examples.zh: 越野賽跑每年秋天在公園舉行。

examples.en: The children crouched behind the sofa during hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 孩子們玩捉迷藏時蹲在沙發後面。

examples.en: She crouched down to tie her shoelace.
examples.zh: 她蹲下來繫鞋帶。

examples.en: The cat crouched in the grass before it jumped.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在跳起來之前先蹲伏在草叢中。

examples.en: A police cruiser stopped outside the school.
examples.zh: 一輛警用巡邏車停在學校外面。

examples.en: They rented a cruiser to tour the harbor.
examples.zh: 他們租了一艘遊艇遊覽港口。

examples.en: The old cruiser is now a museum.
examples.zh: 那艘老巡洋艦現在是博物館。

examples.en: There were bread crumbs all over the table.
examples.zh: 桌上到處都是麵包屑。

examples.en: She brushed the crumbs off her lap.
examples.zh: 她拍掉腿上的碎屑。

examples.en: There wasn't a crumb of food left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡連一點食物都不剩。

examples.en: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
examples.zh: 那面老牆在雨後開始崩塌。

examples.en: She crumbled the cookie into small pieces.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾捏成小碎片。

examples.en: Their plan crumbled when the money ran out.
examples.zh: 錢用完之後，他們的計畫就瓦解了。

examples.en: He crunched an apple while he watched TV.
examples.zh: 他邊看電視邊嘎吱嘎吱地啃蘋果。

examples.en: The snow crunched under our boots.
examples.zh: 雪在我們的靴子底下嘎吱作響。

examples.en: Please don't crunch ice during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時請不要嘎吱嘎吱地嚼冰塊。

senses.zh: 嘎吱聲；緊要關頭；脆脆的口感

examples.en: We heard the crunch of gravel under the car.
examples.zh: 我們聽到碎石在車輪下發出的嘎吱聲。

examples.en: When the crunch came, the whole team worked all night.
examples.zh: 緊要關頭來臨時，整個團隊工作了一整夜。

examples.en: This cereal has a nice crunch.
examples.zh: 這種麥片吃起來有很棒的脆脆口感。

examples.en: She cut the crust off her sandwich.
examples.zh: 她把三明治的麵包皮切掉。

examples.en: The pie has a thin, golden crust.
examples.zh: 這個派的餅皮薄薄的，呈金黃色。

examples.en: The Earth's crust is made of rock.
examples.zh: 地殼是由岩石構成的。

examples.en: The tank holds ten cubic meters of water.
examples.zh: 這個水槽可以裝十立方公尺的水。

examples.en: Volume is measured in cubic centimeters.
examples.zh: 體積是以立方公分來計算的。

examples.en: A cubic box is easy to stack.
examples.zh: 立方體的盒子很容易堆疊。

examples.en: The festival will culminate in a big fireworks show.
examples.zh: 慶典將以盛大的煙火秀達到高潮。

examples.en: Months of training culminated in a gold medal.
examples.zh: 數個月的訓練最終換來一面金牌。

examples.en: The long argument culminated in a handshake.
examples.zh: 這場冗長的爭論最後以握手作結。

examples.en: The teacher explained how a cult controls its members.
examples.zh: 老師說明邪教如何控制成員。

examples.en: The writer was surprised by the cult of celebrity online.
examples.zh: 這位作家對網路上的名人崇拜風潮感到驚訝。

examples.en: Fans created a cult around the young singer.
examples.zh: 粉絲圍繞著這位年輕歌手形成了狂熱崇拜。

examples.en: Cost cutting is common in big companies.
examples.zh: 成本削減在大公司很常見。

examples.en: She kept a cutting from the newspaper about her son.
examples.zh: 她保留了一篇有關兒子的剪報。

examples.en: I planted a cutting from my aunt's rose bush.
examples.zh: 我種下了從阿姨的玫瑰叢剪下的插條。

examples.en: His cutting remark hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他尖刻的話傷了她的感情。

examples.en: The cutting wind made us hurry indoors.
examples.zh: 刺骨的寒風讓我們趕緊進到屋內。

examples.en: The cutting blade of the machine must be cleaned.
examples.zh: 機器上鋒利的刀片必須清潔。

examples.en: A can of soup is shaped like a cylinder.
examples.zh: 一罐湯的形狀像圓柱體。

examples.en: The engine has four cylinders.
examples.zh: 這具引擎有四個汽缸。

examples.en: The diver carried a heavy oxygen cylinder.
examples.zh: 潛水員揹著一個沉重的氧氣瓶。

examples.en: Daffodils bloom in early spring.
examples.zh: 水仙花在早春綻放。

examples.en: She put a bunch of daffodils in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把一束水仙花插進花瓶。

examples.en: My grandmother grows a daffodil in a pot on her balcony.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在陽台的花盆裡種了一株水仙花。

examples.en: The actress was made a dame for her charity work.
examples.zh: 這位女演員因慈善工作被封為女爵士。

examples.en: The school invited a dame who helped start the hospital.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位協助創辦醫院的女爵士。

examples.en: In the play, an old dame tells the children a story.
examples.zh: 劇中一位年長的女士對孩子們說故事。

examples.en: This shampoo helps get rid of dandruff.
examples.zh: 這款洗髮精有助於去除頭皮屑。

examples.en: He brushed the dandruff off his dark jacket.
examples.zh: 他拍掉深色外套上的頭皮屑。

examples.en: Dry air can make dandruff worse in winter.
examples.zh: 乾燥的空氣在冬天會讓頭皮屑更嚴重。

examples.en: The designer wore a daring red dress to the show.
examples.zh: 設計師穿了一件大膽的紅色洋裝出席秀場。

examples.en: It was a daring plan to open a shop in a small town.
examples.zh: 在小鎮開店是個大膽的計畫。

examples.en: The daring boy jumped off the high diving board.
examples.zh: 那個大膽的男孩從高跳台跳了下去。

examples.en: Her daring surprised everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 她的膽量讓班上每個人都感到驚訝。

examples.en: It takes daring to speak in front of a big crowd.
examples.zh: 要在一大群人面前說話需要膽量。

examples.en: He admired the daring of the young pilots.
examples.zh: 他很欽佩那些年輕飛行員的膽識。

examples.en: He threw a dart at the board and hit the center.
examples.zh: 他朝靶投出一支飛鏢，正中紅心。

examples.en: We played darts at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在派對上玩飛鏢。

examples.en: She bought a set of darts for her brother.
examples.zh: 她買了一組飛鏢給她哥哥。

examples.en: The squirrel darted up the tree.
examples.zh: 松鼠飛快地竄上樹。

examples.en: A child darted across the street.
examples.zh: 一個小孩突然衝過馬路。

examples.en: His eyes darted around the room.
examples.zh: 他的目光在房間裡四處游移。

examples.en: Her day-to-day work includes answering emails.
examples.zh: 她的日常工作包括回覆電子郵件。

examples.en: We are trying to cut our day-to-day costs.
examples.zh: 我們正努力減少日常開銷。

examples.en: The manager handles the day-to-day running of the shop.
examples.zh: 經理負責店裡的日常營運。

examples.en: We left for the mountain at daybreak.
examples.zh: 我們在黎明時出發前往山區。

examples.en: The farmers get up before daybreak.
examples.zh: 農夫們在天亮之前就起床。

examples.en: The sky turned pink at daybreak.
examples.zh: 破曉時天空變成粉紅色。

examples.en: Honest dealing is important in business.
examples.zh: 誠實的交易對商業很重要。

examples.en: I have had no dealings with that company.
examples.zh: 我從未和那家公司有過往來。

examples.en: His dealing with customers is always polite.
examples.zh: 他對待顧客的方式總是很有禮貌。

examples.en: Students learn the decimal system in elementary school.
examples.zh: 學生在小學學習十進位制。

examples.en: A decimal point separates whole numbers from fractions.
examples.zh: 小數點把整數與小數部分分開。

examples.en: Our country adopted a decimal currency long ago.
examples.zh: 我們國家很久以前就採用十進位的貨幣。

examples.en: Write the fraction as a decimal.
examples.zh: 把這個分數寫成小數。

examples.en: Round the decimal to two places.
examples.zh: 把這個小數四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

examples.en: The number 0.5 is a decimal equal to one half.
examples.zh: 0.5 是等於二分之一的小數。

examples.en: She bought some decorative pillows for the sofa.
examples.zh: 她為沙發買了幾個裝飾用的抱枕。

examples.en: The vase is more decorative than useful.
examples.zh: 這個花瓶裝飾性多於實用性。

examples.en: Decorative lights hung across the street.
examples.zh: 街道上方掛著裝飾用的燈。

examples.en: The king issued a decree to lower taxes.
examples.zh: 國王頒布了降低稅金的法令。

examples.en: The government issued a decree on clean water.
examples.zh: 政府頒布了有關潔淨用水的法令。

examples.en: By decree, the park closes at nine.
examples.zh: 依法令規定，公園九點關閉。

examples.en: The mayor decreed that the street would be closed.
examples.zh: 市長下令封閉這條街。

examples.en: The law decreed that all children must attend school.
examples.zh: 法律規定所有兒童都必須上學。

examples.en: The committee decreed a day of rest.
examples.zh: 委員會宣布放假一天。

senses.zh: 敬業的；專心投入的；專用的

examples.en: She is a dedicated teacher who loves her students.
examples.zh: 她是位敬業的老師，很愛她的學生。

examples.en: The library has a dedicated area for children.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一區是兒童專用區。

examples.en: The dedicated volunteers worked all weekend.
examples.zh: 專心投入的志工整個週末都在工作。

examples.en: From the footprints, we deduced that someone had been here.
examples.zh: 從腳印我們推斷有人來過。

examples.en: She deduced the answer from the clues in the text.
examples.zh: 她從文章中的線索推斷出答案。

examples.en: Can you deduce what he is thinking from his face?
examples.zh: 你能從他的表情推測他在想什麼嗎？

examples.en: A small deduction is made from your salary for insurance.
examples.zh: 你的薪水會被扣除一小筆保險費。

examples.en: Tax deductions can save you a lot of money.
examples.zh: 稅額扣除額可以幫你省下很多錢。

examples.en: His deduction turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他的推論結果是正確的。

examples.en: The defender blocked the ball before it reached the goal.
examples.zh: 後衛在球射進球門前把球擋了下來。

examples.en: She is a strong defender of children's rights.
examples.zh: 她是兒童權利的堅定捍衛者。

examples.en: The defender of the title lost in the final round.
examples.zh: 衛冕者在決賽中落敗。

examples.en: The defiant child refused to put on his coat.
examples.zh: 那個反抗的孩子不肯穿上外套。

examples.en: She gave a defiant look and kept walking.
examples.zh: 她投以不服氣的眼神，繼續往前走。

examples.en: The workers were defiant and kept asking for fair pay.
examples.zh: 工人們態度反抗，持續要求合理的薪資。

examples.en: Vitamin D deficiency can make you feel tired.
examples.zh: 缺乏維生素 D 會讓人覺得疲倦。

examples.en: The report pointed out a deficiency in the school's safety plan.
examples.zh: 報告指出學校的安全計畫有缺失。

examples.en: There is a deficiency of clean water in some villages.
examples.zh: 有些村莊缺乏乾淨的水。

senses.zh: 缺乏的；不足的；有缺陷的

examples.en: Her diet is deficient in iron.
examples.zh: 她的飲食缺乏鐵質。

examples.en: The deficient wiring in the old building was replaced.
examples.zh: 老建築裡有缺陷的電線被換掉了。

examples.en: The team was deficient in experience.
examples.zh: 這支團隊經驗不足。

examples.en: The friendly debate degenerated into a loud argument.
examples.zh: 這場友善的辯論惡化成大聲爭吵。

examples.en: Without exercise, muscles degenerate over time.
examples.zh: 缺乏運動的話，肌肉會隨時間退化。

examples.en: The weather degenerated into a storm by evening.
examples.zh: 天氣到了傍晚惡化成暴風雨。

examples.en: Pollution can degrade the quality of river water.
examples.zh: 汙染會使河水的品質變差。

examples.en: Don't degrade others by making fun of them.
examples.zh: 別嘲笑別人而貶低他們。

examples.en: Plastic bags take years to degrade.
examples.zh: 塑膠袋要花上好幾年才會分解。

examples.en: He received a notice about his delinquent bill.
examples.zh: 他收到了關於拖欠帳單的通知。

examples.en: The delinquent student was asked to see the counselor.
examples.zh: 行為不良的學生被要求去見輔導老師。

examples.en: Delinquent taxpayers must pay a late fee.
examples.zh: 拖欠稅款的納稅人必須繳納滯納金。

examples.en: The demise of the old theater made the neighborhood sad.
examples.zh: 老戲院的終結讓街坊感到難過。

examples.en: The new app led to the demise of paper tickets.
examples.zh: 新的應用程式使紙本票券走向消亡。

examples.en: The company's demise surprised its workers.
examples.zh: 這間公司的倒閉讓員工很驚訝。

examples.en: The demonstrators marched peacefully through the city.
examples.zh: 示威者和平地走過市區。

examples.en: A demonstrator showed us how to use the new machine in the store.
examples.zh: 一位示範人員在店裡向我們展示如何使用新機器。

examples.en: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered to ask for cleaner air.
examples.zh: 數百名示威者聚集要求更乾淨的空氣。

examples.en: The red light denotes danger.
examples.zh: 紅燈表示危險。

examples.en: In math, the letter x often denotes an unknown number.
examples.zh: 在數學中，常用某個字母來表示未知數。

examples.en: This symbol denotes a rest area on the map.
examples.zh: 這個符號在地圖上代表休息區。

examples.en: Teachers denounced cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 老師們公開譴責考試作弊。

examples.en: The mayor denounced the dumping of waste in the river.
examples.zh: 市長公開譴責在河裡傾倒廢棄物的行為。

examples.en: Many fans denounced the unfair decision of the referee.
examples.zh: 許多球迷指責裁判不公平的判決。

examples.en: The deployment of new buses will begin next month.
examples.zh: 新公車的部署將在下個月開始。

examples.en: The company announced the deployment of its new software.
examples.zh: 公司宣布新軟體即將上線。

examples.en: The deployment of more staff helped during the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 增派人員在連假的繁忙時期有所幫助。

examples.en: Visitors who break the law may be deported.
examples.zh: 違法的訪客可能被驅逐出境。

examples.en: The man was deported after his visa expired.
examples.zh: 那名男子在簽證到期後被遣送出境。

examples.en: Officials decided to deport him back to his home country.
examples.zh: 官員決定將他遣返回國。

examples.en: She is a descendant of a famous painter.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名畫家的後代。

examples.en: Birds are the descendants of dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 鳥類是恐龍的後代。

examples.en: The farm was passed down to the descendants of the founder.
examples.zh: 這座農場傳給了創辦人的子孫。

examples.en: The city designated this area as a park.
examples.zh: 市政府將這一帶指定為公園。

examples.en: Please designate one person to speak for your group.
examples.zh: 請指派一個人代表你們這組發言。

examples.en: Yellow lines designate the parking spaces.
examples.zh: 黃線標示出停車位。

examples.en: They live in a detached house with a garden.
examples.zh: 他們住在有花園的獨棟房屋。

examples.en: He sounded detached when he talked about the problem.
examples.zh: 他談到這個問題時聽起來很冷漠。

examples.en: The detached handle was lying on the floor.
examples.zh: 分離出來的把手掉在地上。

examples.en: Early detection of the disease saves lives.
examples.zh: 及早發現疾病能救人命。

examples.en: The airport uses new equipment for the detection of dangerous items.
examples.zh: 機場使用新設備來偵測危險物品。

examples.en: The cat avoided detection by hiding under the bed.
examples.zh: 那隻貓躲在床下，沒被發現。

examples.en: His health began to deteriorate last winter.
examples.zh: 他的健康從去年冬天開始惡化。

examples.en: The weather will deteriorate this weekend.
examples.zh: 這週末天氣會變差。

examples.en: The old bridge deteriorated because nobody fixed it.
examples.zh: 舊橋因為沒人修理而逐漸損壞。

examples.en: Doctors noticed a deterioration in her condition.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到她的病情惡化了。

examples.en: The deterioration of the road made driving unsafe.
examples.zh: 道路的損壞使開車變得不安全。

examples.en: The deterioration in air quality worries parents.
examples.zh: 空氣品質惡化讓家長們擔心。

examples.en: The government decided to devalue its currency.
examples.zh: 政府決定讓本國貨幣貶值。

examples.en: Don't devalue your own work.
examples.zh: 不要貶低你自己的成果。

examples.en: Too many copies can devalue a famous painting.
examples.zh: 太多複製品可能讓名畫貶值。
